title: Pilot case studies
description: A deep aubergine band: a small uppercase eyebrow, a big white heading and two outlined round arrow buttons, then a sideways track of wide square-cornered cards bleeding off the right edge. Each card is a white panel with a title and a three-step timeline (problem, what we built, the result as a quote) threaded on a thin vertical line with dots, a violet pill and an outlined pill, beside a tall photo washed in violet with the customer's name on it. Swipe or step with the arrows; snaps card by card. Ends on a white statement with a violet brush stroke.
notes: needs JavaScript for the arrows only; the track swipes and snaps without it
the band is the theme's secondary colour (aubergine in pilot-theme); on phones the photo is hidden
